I'm a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University who enjoys
turning complex data into clear, honest stories. I'm especially interested in
how statistics can support better decisions about the environment, and in
making research findings accessible to people who don't work with data every day.

Before Monash, I studied my undergrad in BBA( Business Analytics). My whole experience taught me
that the best analysis is useless if nobody understands it.

On this blog, I take published research and translate it into plain language,
with visualisations designed for the people the findings matter to most.

## Skills

R (tidyverse, ggplot2) · Quarto · Data visualisation · Statistical modelling ·
Data communication

## Education

**Monash University** | Master of Business Analytics | 2026–2028
